title: DeMeco Ryans on Texans defense: I don't believe in hype, this isn't 2025, we have to earn it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: DeMeco Ryans on Texans defense: I don't believe in hype, this isn't 2025, we have to earn it
sources.description: Leading up to the 2026 season, there was plenty of talk about how good the Texans defense could be — that the unit could help lead Houston to a deep postseason run.
